title: Shoptimism, Mirumi, and Minecraft mommies
content:
Hi everyone! The latest episode of Power User is out! This week, I spoke to investigative climate journalist Miranda Green about her latest piece for Desmog. She dug into the American Conservation Coalition (ACC), which was founded in 2018 as a Republican answer to the youth climate movement.

The ACC once championed clean energy and public lands. But now, backed by oil billionaires and Big Tech giants like Amazon, the group has pivoted to co-sponsoring "Drill, Baby, Drill" campus tours and pushing federal legislation to deregulate AI data center construction on public lands.

We discuss how Silicon Valley and Big Oil have formed an unlikely alliance, the debate over building AI data centers on toxic Superfund sites, and more!

Below are the things I’m reading/following going into the weekend. Hopefully this week’s newsletter gives you some fun topics of discussion over the Thanksgiving dinner table. Have a wonderful holiday!!! <3
